title: Vanex releases a new track titled “Look What Love Did To Me”
htmlContent:
Fast-rising music star, Vanex is an American-based singer and songwriter who has taken out time to learn all he needs to know about his craft. The poetic genius does not disappoint in the release of his recent song titled “Look What Love Did To Me.”

Vanex’s gets in his bag to deliver a sure-fire banger on his recent track “Look What Love Did To Me.'' The element in the music shows us how great lyricism counts, and that presence in the flow makes the delivery have that much more conviction than any other thing.
